headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headers.purpose: Browsers only ever connect over HTTPS, even if a link says http://.

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.value: inline JS blocked · scripts from self + 3 origins · object-src 'none' · frame-ancestors 'none' · base-uri 'self'
headers.purpose: Only approved sources may load; injected scripts, plugins, and framing are blocked.

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.purpose: No other site can embed these pages in a frame (clickjacking).

headers.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headers.purpose: Files are only used as their declared type, never guessed (MIME sniffing).

headers.name: Referrer-Policy
headers.purpose: Other sites only see the domain a visitor came from, not the full URL.

headers.name: Permissions-Policy
headers.value: camera, microphone, geolocation, payment, usb, browsing-topics off
headers.purpose: Browser features the site never uses are switched off for it and any embed.
